scope: Post-run geometry diagnosis; no quantum calculation, candidate filtering, literature atomic coordinates, or reference-derived geometry
image_convention: N at stored coordinate; H = stored H + donor_NH_image_shift @ cell; O = stored O + oxygen_image_from_N @ cell
neighborhood: Every distinct cross-chain O image with N...O <= 6 A OR H...O <= 6 A; same-chain O excluded by source chain identity
threshold_role: Only diagnoses this already-selected trajectory; does not alter filtering, ranking or eligibility

chain_geometry.centroid_convention: Fixed initial covalent-graph BFS branch cut; temporal changes are independent of that fixed cut. Absolute axial centroids depend on chosen chain segment; use locally connected amide groups and N anchors for registry.
chain_geometry.chain_axis: c from periodic winding, not a fitted finite-segment direction

sensitivity.role: Post-run sensitivity only, not candidate filtering or chemical proof

detector_audit.angle_definition: angle N-H-O at H = acos((-N_to_H) dot H_to_O / lengths); collinear N-H...O gives 180 degrees
